deploy-bot: [CI] Pipeline started for staging - commit abcdef12 (tag: v1.14.0-rc2). Steps: build ▸ unit ▸ integration ▸ lint. URL: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/5678
sam: saw a lint fail on parallel run? getting the slack notif now
jin: deploy-bot posted failure: lint step failed on worker-7. Error snippet: 'no-unused-vars' in js/lib/runner.js:142
deploy-bot: [CI] Step `lint` failed (exit 1). Full log: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/5678/logs/lint
maya: is this flaky or a real regression? last canary passed yesterday. We have change window until 18:00 PDT. If this is a dep bump we should pin, otherwise we can fastpatch
sam: quick grep -> yarn.lock shows eslint bumped to 8.10.0 in PR #4321. @pranav did you land that change?
pranav: yeah that was my dep bump for the security linting work. I can revert or pin. Repro locally: `yarn install && yarn lint` -> same error
qa-bot: Flakiness alert: lint flake rate baseline 0.4% (7d) -> post-#4321 spike to 9%. Details: https://qa.redwood/internal/reports/lint-spike
jin: suggestion: pin eslint to 8.9.x in package.json (temporary) and re-run CI. If unit/integration also fail then consider rollback of PR 4321
maya: decision: hold canary rollout for now. @pranav open a hotfix PR to pin eslint to 8.9.x and trigger a CI rerun. If green, we'll cherry-pick or fastpatch; otherwise rollback PR 4321
sam: created INF-876 with logs, links, and triage notes
deploy-bot: [CI] Rerun requested by @pranav (build 5679)
deploy-bot: [CI] Build 5679: lint fixed? running unit tests now
pranav: pushed hotfix PR #4333 -> pins eslint@8.9.3 in package.json and yarn.lock. Triggering CI for #4333. Command used locally: `git checkout -b hotfix/pin-eslint && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && git commit -am "pin eslint@8.9.3"`
deploy-bot: [CI] Build 5680 started for PR 4333 (hotfix)
deploy-bot: [CI] Build 5680: lint ✓, unit ✓, integration ✓. All checks green. Tagging artifact v1.14.0-rc2-hotfix. Recommend resume canary after 5m cooldown
maya: thanks — I'll update release notes with the dep pin and link to #4333. Resume rollout when ready
sam: marking release hold cleared. :thumbsup:
pranav: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short postmortem note in the release thread and sync with QA on flake thresholds
jin: added a rule to track large dep bumps to linting infra in the infra backlog
maya: good catch. moving to resume in ~5m
